data.sources_note_en: Each story lists its source and date. Company announcements are attributed and availability follows the documented scope.
data.thesis: 讓AI接手查詢和配對，品牌仍要核對資料與審批
data.thesis_en: As AI handles discovery and matching, brands still need reliable data and approvals
data.thesis_note: 由商品問答到展會配對，先核對輸入資料，再量度每個環節是否完成。
data.thesis_note_en: From product questions to trade-show matching, verify inputs and measure which steps customers and partners complete.

items.title: BigCommerce為合資格商戶推出店內購物助手
items.summary: Commerce.com公布Shopping Agent開始向合資格BigCommerce商戶推出，讓消費者在店內以對話找商品及比較。
highlights: 助手可延續追問、協助加入購物車和引導結帳。
獨立的對話式店內搜尋已供所有付費方案使用。
items.why: 電商團隊可分開檢視商品查詢、加購與結帳，確認顧客在哪一步需要人員協助。
items.next_step: 選一個品類，以用途、尺寸及預算測試查詢，再逐一核對推薦及購物車結果。
items.detail: Commerce.com表示，商戶可調整助手的外觀及品牌呈現，讓顧客在店內問商品、比較選項及加入購物車。Shopping Agent現階段限合資格商戶，對話式搜尋的付費方案範圍則另行列明。團隊可用有多個型號的商品測試，確認追問後顯示的選項仍符合原先條件。
items.title_en: BigCommerce starts rolling out a storefront shopping agent to eligible merchants
items.summary_en: Commerce.com announced the rollout of Shopping Agent to eligible BigCommerce merchants for product discovery and comparison in conversation.
highlights_en: The agent can handle follow-up questions, help add items to the cart and guide checkout.
Separate conversational storefront search is available on all paid plans.
items.why_en: Commerce teams can assess discovery, cart and checkout separately and identify where shoppers need staff support.
items.next_step_en: Test searches in one category by use, size and budget, then reconcile recommendations and cart items.
items.detail_en: Commerce.com says merchants can customize the assistant's presentation and help shoppers compare items and add them to the cart. Shopping Agent currently serves eligible merchants, while the conversational search feature has separate paid-plan availability. Test products with several variants and check that choices still meet the original criteria after follow-up questions.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 博報堂推Shopify商品資料方案，把規格連到使用情境
items.summary: 博報堂與Hakuhodo DY ONE推出Data Enrichment on Shopify，為既有商品資料加入顧客用途和使用情境。
highlights: 擴充資料可在Shopify商品主檔、描述和自訂欄位管理。
外部AI內直接完成購買仍取決於當地支援。
items.why: 電商團隊可核對用途描述是否有原始規格支持，再評估推薦和結帳路徑。
items.next_step: 挑一款商品，逐項列出規格、用途及不適用情況，再核對資料欄位和商品頁。
items.detail: 博報堂描述的方案會把商品規格與顧客想解決的問題建立關聯，再把資料寫入Shopify商品主檔、描述及自訂欄位。公告把外部AI內即時查庫存及完成交易視為隨支援擴展的情境。品牌試做時可先檢查每句用途描述的依據，再逐步驗收推薦、商品頁和結帳連結。各欄位亦可指定資料更新人員。
items.title_en: Hakuhodo adds usage context to Shopify product data
items.summary_en: Hakuhodo and Hakuhodo DY ONE announced Data Enrichment on Shopify to add shopper needs and usage context to existing product data.
highlights_en: Teams can manage enriched information in Shopify product records, descriptions and custom fields.
Completing a purchase inside external AI depends on local support.
items.why_en: Commerce teams can check whether use cases are grounded in product specifications before assessing discovery and checkout.
items.next_step_en: Select one product and verify specifications, use cases, exceptions and fields against its product page.
items.detail_en: Hakuhodo says its solution links product specifications to shopper needs and writes information into Shopify product records, descriptions and custom fields. Real-time inventory checks and purchases inside external AI depend on expanded support. Review the basis for each use case before checking recommendations, product pages and checkout links. Assign an owner to update each field.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Schweppes香港以流動試飲吧配合太古坊分享活動
items.summary: Marketing-Interactive報道，Schweppes在香港以流動試飲吧推廣橙味汽水及佛手柑檸檬汽水，並與太古坊合作舉行分享活動。
highlights: 指定站點設調飲示範，另有商業區街頭試飲。
Taste Talk Thursday邀創意與商界嘉賓分享。
items.why: 飲品團隊可分開設計初次試飲、再次接觸與零售兌換。
items.next_step: 在不同試飲點用獨立兌換碼，比對派發、活動登記及後續到店情況。
items.detail: 據Marketing-Interactive引述品牌代表，Schweppes安排流動試飲吧到文化活動和購物地點，部分場次設調飲示範，另在商業區安排街頭試飲。品牌與太古坊合作的分享系列提供另一個接觸點。評估活動時可把樣品派發、分享活動登記及零售兌換分開計算。
items.title_en: Schweppes Hong Kong pairs a mobile tasting bar with Taikoo Place talks
items.summary_en: Marketing-Interactive reported that Schweppes is promoting Orangeade and Bergamot Lemonade through a mobile tasting bar and a talk series with Taikoo Place.
highlights_en: Selected stops feature mixology demonstrations, alongside street sampling in commercial districts.
Taste Talk Thursday features guests from creative and business fields.
items.why_en: Beverage teams can design distinct steps for first trial, repeat contact and retail redemption.
items.next_step_en: Use different codes by sampling stop to compare distribution, event sign-ups and later store visits.
items.detail_en: Marketing-Interactive cited a brand representative describing mobile sampling at cultural and shopping destinations, with mixology demonstrations at selected stops and additional street sampling in commercial districts. The Taikoo Place talk series provides another touchpoint. Measure samples, sign-ups and retail redemptions separately.

items.title: Taboola完成收購Dianomi，擴充金融媒體廣告版位
items.summary: Taboola宣布完成收購Dianomi，後者的媒體網絡涵蓋商業、金融及生活內容。
highlights: 公司描述的媒體合作例子包括Reuters及CNN Business。
Taboola稱將與其Realize平台結合，公告未列逐項開放日期。
items.why: 金融廣告團隊可重新核對版位環境及合規審閱流程。
items.next_step: 向平台索取可用版位、地區及內容分類，再按客戶規範挑選測試名單。
items.detail: Taboola公布已完成收購Dianomi，並指後者的網絡連接金融廣告主和商業、金融及生活出版商。Taboola描述了與Realize結合的方向，公告未交代每個帳戶可取得的版位及日期。媒體團隊可先按合規要求查核內容環境、地區、價格及報表分類。
items.title_en: Taboola completes Dianomi acquisition, adding a finance-focused publisher network
items.summary_en: Taboola announced that it completed its acquisition of Dianomi, whose network covers business, finance and lifestyle content.
highlights_en: The company named Reuters and CNN Business among publisher examples.
Taboola described combining the network with Realize, with no feature-by-feature release dates in the notice.
items.why_en: Financial advertisers can revisit placement context and approval workflows.
items.next_step_en: Ask for placements, markets and content categories, then shortlist a test using client requirements.
items.detail_en: Taboola says it completed the acquisition of Dianomi, whose network connects financial advertisers with business, finance and lifestyle publishers. Taboola described combining the network with Realize. Inventory access and dates were not specified per account. Media teams can check content context, markets, pricing and reporting against compliance requirements.

items.title: 杭州OrdoAI測試跨市場創作者工具，邀約與價格由團隊把關
items.summary: OrdoAI公布Ordo Brand邀請制測試，支援按市場挑選創作者、準備多語邀約和跟進合作。
highlights: 工具可從創作者回覆提取報價。
團隊保留寄出邀約、議價、確認成片及付款的責任。
items.why: 出海團隊可減少重複整理工作，並用本地人員核對受眾、用詞和報價口徑。
items.next_step: 用兩個市場的小名單試評，核對創作者資料、翻譯及合作條款，再決定是否寄送。
items.detail: OrdoAI表示，Ordo Brand可按目標市場及活動要求整理創作者名單，協助翻譯邀約、從回覆摘出報價，以及提示待處理的合作事項。工具仍屬邀請制測試。品牌團隊需確認寄出的字句、商業條款、成片及付款，並可先抽查不同市場的報價與內容授權口徑。
items.title_en: Hangzhou's OrdoAI tests cross-market creator tools with human control of outreach and pricing
items.summary_en: OrdoAI announced an invite-only Ordo Brand beta for shortlisting creators, preparing multilingual outreach and tracking collaborations.
highlights_en: The tool can extract quoted rates from creator replies.
Teams retain control of sending, pricing, content approval and payments.
items.why_en: Cross-border teams can streamline record-keeping while local teams check audience fit, wording and rates.
items.next_step_en: Try a small list in two markets and validate creator data, translations and terms before sending.
items.detail_en: OrdoAI says Ordo Brand can shortlist creators by market and brief, translate outreach, extract quoted rates and flag items that need follow-up. Access is invitation-only. Brand teams still handle sending, terms, final content and payment. Compare how each market quotes fees and defines content usage rights.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: MCI USA推Jade，將活動報名、住宿與展商跟進串連
items.summary: MCI USA推出Jade，透過其管理服務連接活動報名、住宿及展商商機管理。
highlights: 主辦方可查閱已報名與已訂房的情況。
參展商可掃描名牌、記錄會談及協助評估商機。
items.why: 活動團隊可把出席、酒店預訂與展後跟進分開量度。
items.next_step: 以一場活動檢查報名和住宿資料能否對應，再抽查展商的會談記錄。
items.detail: MCI USA表示，Jade可連接活動報名和酒店資料，協助服務團隊查閱房間供應及已報名未訂房的情況。展商可掃描名牌並使用輔助筆記和商機評估功能。工具現階段透過MCI USA服務提供，活動團隊可先確認資料由誰管理、誰可查看，以及展後如何跟進。
items.title_en: MCI USA launches Jade to link event registration, housing and exhibitor follow-up
items.summary_en: MCI USA introduced Jade through its managed services, linking registration, housing and exhibitor leads.
highlights_en: Organisers can check registration and hotel booking status.
Exhibitors can scan badges, capture notes and use assisted lead scoring.
items.why_en: Event teams can measure attendance, hotel bookings and post-show follow-up separately.
items.next_step_en: Check whether registration and housing records match, then sample exhibitor meeting notes.
items.detail_en: MCI USA says Jade connects registrations and hotel information so service teams can see room inventory and registered attendees without reservations. Exhibitors can scan badges and use assisted notes and lead scoring. Jade is offered through MCI USA services. Event teams can check who owns the data, who can view it and how leads move into follow-up.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Vigloo徵集AI短劇試播片，選中作品有機會製成系列
items.summary: 韓國短劇平台Vigloo公布第二屆全球短劇徵集，邀創作者提交試播片及首五集大綱。
highlights: 提交影片最長三分鐘。
獲簽約者可獲製作點數，成片由平台發行並分成。
items.why: 短內容團隊可先用一集驗證人物和故事能否延續成系列。
items.next_step: 準備試播片前先核對素材授權、製作支援及發行分成條款。
items.detail: Vigloo公布，參加者須以不超過三分鐘的影片展示短劇構想，並提交首五集大綱。公司稱會考慮投稿作品是否適合製成系列，獲邀簽約者才涉及製作點數、發行和分成。團隊可先確認角色、聲音及素材授權是否涵蓋首集以外的後續製作及發行。比賽名次與平台的製作決定分開處理。
items.title_en: Vigloo seeks AI microdrama pilots with a path to series production
items.summary_en: South Korean short-drama platform Vigloo announced its second global festival, inviting a pilot video and a synopsis for the first five episodes.
highlights_en: Submitted videos can run up to three minutes.
Creators who sign a deal can receive production credits, with platform distribution and revenue sharing.
items.why_en: Short-form teams can use one episode to assess whether characters and story can sustain a series.
items.next_step_en: Check rights, production support and distribution terms before preparing a pilot.
items.detail_en: Vigloo says entrants must present their concept in a video of up to three minutes and submit a synopsis for five episodes. It will consider entries for series production. Production credits, distribution and revenue sharing apply to signed deals. Check whether rights to characters, voices and assets cover production and distribution beyond the pilot. Contest rankings and production decisions are separate.

items.title: 香港亞洲美容展以AI配對合資格買家與展商
items.summary: 亞洲美容展主辦方披露，本屆用Match&Meet安排獲選合資格買家與展商一對一洽談。
highlights: 亞洲國際博覽館聚焦成分、包裝及代工供應鏈。
香港會議展覽中心展示香水、美妝等品牌成品。
items.why: 美妝品牌參展前可把採購需求和目標客戶寫成可配對的資料。
items.next_step: 把產品類別、最低訂購量及目標市場填入展商資料，並記錄會後商機。
items.detail: 主辦方在展會公告中披露，買家計劃為獲選合資格買家安排個別行程，AI配對平台可協助他們與展商安排一對一洽談。供應鏈及品牌成品分設兩場，品牌可按目的準備不同資料。檢視效果時，可把成功配對、實際會面和展後商機分開記錄。這樣可辨識需要改善的是名單、邀約還是跟進。
items.title_en: Hong Kong's Cosmoprof Asia uses AI matching for selected buyers and exhibitors
items.summary_en: Cosmoprof Asia organisers described Match&Meet, which helps schedule one-to-one meetings between selected qualified buyers and exhibitors.
highlights_en: AsiaWorld-Expo focused on ingredients, packaging and manufacturing suppliers.
The Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre showcased branded goods including fragrance and beauty products.
items.why_en: Beauty brands can describe sourcing needs and target customers in a form a matching system can use.
items.next_step_en: Add categories, minimum order quantities and target markets to exhibitor profiles and track follow-up leads.
items.detail_en: The organisers said the buyer programme created tailored itineraries for selected qualified buyers. An AI matching platform helps arrange one-to-one meetings with exhibitors. Suppliers and finished brands exhibited at separate venues. Track matches, actual meetings and post-event leads separately when evaluating the process. This helps identify whether to improve the shortlist, invitations or follow-up.

items.title: MUJI新加坡以成對畫面展示旅行用品的日常用法
items.summary: MUJI新加坡與ANAK合作，為MUJI to GO推出Travel, Every Day，把同件用品放在日常和旅行場景。
highlights: 其中一組創意用掛式收納包示範辦公和旅行用途。
活動安排在新加坡指定戶外版位、門店、社交及電商等渠道推廣。
items.why: 零售創意團隊可用同一商品示範不同使用場合，讓功能差異一眼可見。
items.next_step: 選一款商品，做一組通勤和旅行畫面，在門店與電商頁使用一致產品標示。
items.detail: Campaign Brief Asia報道，新加坡團隊以本地常見場景製作成對畫面，用同件MUJI to GO用品展示日常和旅行用途。創意包括把掛式收納包用於辦公用品或旅行護理品。活動計劃跨戶外、門店、社交及電商推廣，品牌可比較不同場景帶來的具體商品查詢。
items.title_en: MUJI Singapore pairs travel and everyday scenes in product creative
items.summary_en: MUJI Singapore and ANAK introduced Travel, Every Day for MUJI to GO, placing the same product in travel and everyday settings.
highlights_en: One execution shows a hanging case for office essentials and travel toiletries.
The Singapore plan covers selected outdoor sites, stores, social and ecommerce.
items.why_en: Retail teams can demonstrate distinct uses for the same item so its function is clear.
items.next_step_en: Pick one item, create commute and travel scenes and use consistent product labels in store and online.
items.detail_en: Campaign Brief Asia reported that the Singapore team pairs familiar local scenes, showing the same MUJI to GO product in everyday and travel use. One example uses a hanging case for desk essentials or travel toiletries. Plans span outdoor, stores, social and ecommerce. Compare the product questions each scene generates.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Certis以巡查案例說明人員、機械人及AI的分工
items.summary: Certis公布Built for What's Next品牌活動，以巡查機械人與營運平台說明技術如何支援前線人員。
highlights: 公司列出Wallace巡查及Mozart整合營運資訊的角色。
新加坡榜鵝數碼園區是試點場景之一。
items.why: 企業服務品牌可用可指認的工作場景解釋AI用途，並說明由誰作決定。
items.next_step: 選一項前線工作，畫出人員、裝置及系統的交接，再用同一案例測試銷售說明。
items.detail: Certis把機械人巡查和營運協調放進品牌故事。公司稱Wallace用於巡查，Mozart把資料及工作流程匯集供團隊處理，重要決定仍由人員作出。新加坡榜鵝數碼園區是公司列舉的試點之一。團隊可參考案例對照品牌文案中的每項職責是否有現場例子。試點的結論應按場地分開記錄。
items.title_en: Certis uses a patrol case to show the roles of staff, robots and AI
items.summary_en: Certis launched Built for What's Next, illustrating how patrol robots and operations tools support front-line staff.
highlights_en: The company describes Wallace patrols and Mozart's role in connecting operations information.
Singapore's Punggol Digital District is a named testbed.
items.why_en: B2B services brands can explain AI through named tasks and show who makes decisions.
items.next_step_en: Map handoffs between people, devices and systems for one task and use the same case in sales materials.
items.detail_en: Certis brings robot patrols and operations coordination into its brand story. It says Wallace patrols sites and Mozart connects data and workflows for teams, with people retaining key decisions. Punggol Digital District is one named testbed in Singapore. Check that each role in the campaign has a concrete example. Keep pilot findings specific to each site.
